representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated Supabase environment with no provisioned agent credentials

rowCountQueries: Count existing auth.users and verify no agent identity rows exist before apply
Inventory public grants and RLS state for agent_identities, agent_credentials, and agent_audit_events
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Three additive tables and 17 pending directory rows; no auth users or credentials are created

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply the idempotent migration in an isolated environment; use a later additive migration for corrections
execution.idempotency: CREATE TABLE/INDEX/EXTENSION and seed INSERT use IF NOT EXISTS or ON CONFLICT guards

quarantine.strategy: No user or tenant data is backfilled; all identities remain pending until explicitly provisioned

constraints: Unique agent slug and optional auth user link
Status, JSON shape, secret hash length, and credential lifecycle checks
indexes: Active credential lookup by agent and lifecycle
Agent audit events by principal/time and resource
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Apply to an isolated database; verify RLS, grants, seed count, no raw secret columns, and service-role-only access

recovery.rollback: Disable the provisioning utility and retain the additive directory; do not delete auth users or reset a persistent database
recovery.forwardFix: Add corrected constraints or policies in a later migration

queries: Verify all three tables exist with expected columns, indexes, and RLS enabled
Verify anon/authenticated have no table privileges
Verify exactly 17 pending identities and zero agent credentials
Verify provisioned identities are explicitly linked and active before accepting agent requests
